commitResults.messageTitle: Improve UI: overhaul UI with light vintage theme, splash screen, and detail panel
commitResults.messageBody:
New components:
- Add SplashScreen shown on startup with fade-in animation and SPACE-to-enter
- Add CatDetailPanel displaying full cat info (image, name, location, health, traits)
- Add CatSidebarCard as a compact sidebar list entry showing only index and name
- Add MomoSignature-Regular.ttf custom font used in app header and splash screen

Layout & navigation changes:
- Restructure MainWindow into a two-column SplitPane (sidebar list + detail panel)
- Lock SplitPane divider to prevent user resizing
- Wire UP/DOWN arrow keys in CommandBox to navigate the cat list without losing focus
- Disable mouse-based list selection; navigation is keyboard-only
- Auto-select first cat on load and re-select after list filter changes

Theme (DarkTheme.css):
- Replace dark theme with "CatPals" light vintage palette:
    cream (#fdfcdc) background, deep teal (#0081a7) text/borders,
    cyan (#00afb9) selections, peach (#fed9b7) result display,
    coral (#f07167) command bar and error indicators
- Switch base font from Segoe UI to Georgia (serif) throughout

Bug fixes & polish:
- Restore saved window size/position before showing any scene (UiManager)
- Clear command text field on parse/command error (CommandBox)
- Fix confirmation alert dialogs being clipped: set resizable + minWidth 420
- Apply programmatic window-nudge workaround for JavaFX first-layout sizing bug
- Remove unused F1 menu accelerator and associated workaround code

Removed:
- Delete export.html (stale artefact)
